search_console.decision: The September 7–October 4 report showed 1,214 impressions, two clicks, 0.2% CTR, and average position 35.3. Yesterday's Stem Cell CBG expansion already addressed the only nontrivial position 4–20 signal (13 impressions, one click, 7.7% CTR, position 5.3), so no second Data-led page was justified. Position 4–20 rows with one to four impressions, the single Oklahoma query click, and small homepage/about samples were deliberately ignored. The report's stale failing WordPress sitemap URL did justify a technical compatibility mirror of the current sitemap.

authority.action: Published a CDC-, NCCIH-, AHRQ-, and FDA-grounded chronic-pain evidence guide with a clinician-ready pain, function, product, benefit, and harm record; connected it to medication, fall-safety, topical, and procedure paths; expanded the rolling-tray guide into transparent task-and-storage fit math; and logged U.S. Pain Foundation as a qualified resource-review opportunity. No outreach was sent.
